clue.text: Investigate chopper turning in front of pit

indicators.note: in front of places the turned chopper before the pit word
turning means the word for the chopper is read backwards

parts.note: an axe is a chopping tool
a mine is a pit dug for coal

explanation.surface: Someone probes an axe found lying in front of a pit.
explanation.definitionFit: To scrutinise or inspect something closely is a direct synonym of investigate.

indicators.note: section of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A drill bores through part of the ornate ceiling of the Alhambra palace in Granada.
explanation.definitionFit: A brace is a hand tool for boring holes, the carpenter's brace and bit, so it is a kind of drill.

clue.text: Criminal, one detained by the force

indicators.note: detained by means the one is held inside the words that follow

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
F is the physics symbol for force

explanation.surface: A villain, one of a gang, is arrested by the police force.
explanation.definitionFit: A robber or stealer is one kind of criminal, an example of the broader term.

indicators.note: in means the voting word goes inside the river

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Wales, England and Scotland
voters put a cross on the ballot paper, so to put a cross is to vote

explanation.surface: An angry fan has dropped a crucifix into a river.
explanation.definitionFit: A keen follower or fan of something is a synonym for an enthusiast.

clue.text: Group of soldiers having no time for diet

indicators.note: having no means the time letter is dropped from the soldiers

parts.note: a regiment is a unit of soldiers

explanation.surface: Busy troops have no time to think about their diet.
explanation.definitionFit: A prescribed course of eating, as set by a doctor, is a regimen, so it is a synonym of diet.

definitions.meaning: bewildered and confused, not knowing what to do
out on the water of the English Channel, the sea between England and France

explanation.surface: Someone has gone missing in the English Channel.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for being bewildered also literally describes a ship out on the ocean, as anywhere in the Channel is.

parts.note: as means like, in a comparison
a hen is a female bird

explanation.surface: Someone resembling a woman has gone pale.
explanation.definitionFit: Grey and pale as cinders, the face of someone in shock is described with this adjective meaning colourless.

clue.text: Set about interrupting man from Mediterranean island

indicators.note: interrupting means the turned word breaks into the man word

parts.note: a male is a man

indicators.note: about means the word set is turned round and read backwards

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A set of people breaks in on a man who comes from Malta.
explanation.definitionFit: Malta is the Mediterranean island, and its adjective describes something or someone coming from there.

clue.text: Attempt to swallow whole onion-like bulb

indicators.note: to swallow means the attempt word takes the whole word inside it

parts.note: a shot is an attempt, as in have a shot
all means the whole

explanation.surface: Someone tries to gulp down an entire onion-like bulb.
explanation.definitionFit: This small mild bulb of the allium family is closely related to the onion and used the same way in cooking.

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for Conservative, the UK party
a rash is an outbreak of spots on the skin

explanation.surface: A Tory politician sees a calamity on the stock market coming.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden collapse of share prices is called by this term, as in the Wall Street calamity of 1929.

clue.text: Doctor, for example, beginning to sip the last of the wine?

parts.note: EG is the abbreviation for for example, from Latin exempli gratia

indicators.note: beginning to means only the opening letter of sip is used

explanation.surface: A doctor starts sipping what remains of the wine.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that the definition is by example: sediment at the bottom of a bottle is one kind of what is left.
explanation.definitionFit: Sediment left at the bottom of a bottle or glass is called by this word, the residue after pouring.

clue.text: Republic is at one after turmoil

indicators.note: after turmoil means the letters of is at one are thrown into disorder and rearranged

explanation.surface: A nation is finally at peace once its unrest is over.
explanation.definitionFit: This Baltic state, independent since 1991, is a republic, one example of the category.

definitions.meaning: port is the nautical word for the ...-hand side of a ship

explanation.definitionFit: Departed is a past tense of to go away, and port is the sailor's term for the left-hand side.

definitions.meaning: in the Royal Navy a sailor without officer rank is called by this term

explanation.definitionFit: Grading is to give a score, and the Royal Navy uses the same word for a non-commissioned sailor.

indicators.note: turned means the two letters of it are read in the other direction

parts.note: FF is fortissimo, the musical marking for very loud

explanation.surface: A quarrel turned into a shouting match.
explanation.definitionFit: A petty quarrel or minor squabble is called by this word, so it is a small argument.

clue.text: University in Berkshire with duller stuff in library?

parts.note: the University of Reading is in the town of Reading in Berkshire, an English county west of London
matt means dull, without shine, so more dull is matter

explanation.surface: A university in Berkshire comes with rather boring material in its library.
explanation.walkthrough: Duller is read as the comparative of matt, a paint finish without gloss, rather than the usual sense of more boring.
explanation.definitionFit: Books, magazines and papers found in a library are all items to peruse, the general phrase for such material.

indicators.note: rogue as an adjective means wild and uncontrolled, so the letters of a lovable are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone is first and foremost a charming scoundrel.
explanation.definitionFit: Chiefly and most importantly are synonyms, both meaning more than anything else.

parts.note: a fellow is a man

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word sit is read from bottom to top, backwards

explanation.surface: A bug gets a man to sit up and take notice.
explanation.definitionFit: The praying mantis is a predatory insect that holds its forelegs as if in prayer.

indicators.note: fresh means the letters of green tea are made new, put into a new order

explanation.surface: A grocer or cafe brings out newly brewed green tea.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring about or create, as power stations do with electricity, is a synonym of produce.

parts.note: the verge, a strip of grass beside a road, is found next to the way; by the way pretends to be an aside

explanation.surface: An invitation to undress, mentioned in passing.
explanation.definitionFit: The verge or border alongside a highway is a strip of land lying literally by the way.

clue.text: Somalian disturbed subject of famous painting

indicators.note: disturbed means the letters of Somalian are jumbled into another order

explanation.surface: A troubled person from Somalia sat for a celebrated portrait.
explanation.definitionFit: Leonardo da Vinci's portrait in the Louvre shows Lisa Gherardini, its famous sitter.

clue.text: Receive information about the French doctor

indicators.note: about means the hearing word goes round the French article

parts.note: to hear is to receive news or information
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Someone gets news about a French physician.
explanation.definitionFit: Anyone who cures illness or injury, such as a physician, is a curer, the general term here.

clue.text: Name of woman showing real patience regularly

indicators.note: regularly means every other letter of real patience is taken, starting with the second

explanation.surface: A woman is known for her genuine forbearance.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a female given name, made famous by the Arthurian maid of Astolat in Tennyson.

indicators.note: in speech means the place word is spoken and its sound gives a differently spelt word

parts.note: a site is a place or location

explanation.surface: A speaker refers to a location during a talk.
explanation.definitionFit: To quote or refer to something as an example or authority is a synonym of mention.

clue.text: Intensity of feeling in preliminary round of contest

definitions.meaning: a qualifying race in athletics or swimming, whose winners go through to the final

explanation.surface: Passions run high in the early stages of a competition.
explanation.definitionFit: Warmth names strong passion, and a qualifying race in athletics also takes this word.
